name: Build IPA for TrollStore

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: macos-14
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Select Xcode
        run: sudo xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode_15.2.app
      - name: Build Archive
        run: |
          xcodebuild clean archive \
            -scheme SolarEngineer \
            -destination "generic/platform=iOS" \
            -archivePath build/SolarEngineer.xcarchive
      - name: Export IPA
        run: |
          echo '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><plist version="1.0"><dict><key>method</key><string>development</string></dict></plist>' > exportOptions.plist
          xcodebuild -exportArchive \
            -archivePath build/SolarEngineer.xcarchive \
            -exportPath build/ipa \
            -exportOptionsPlist exportOptions.plist
      - name: Upload IPA
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: SolarEngineer-IPA
          path: build/ipa/*.ipa
